name: awesome-selfhosted
description_en: A list of Free Software network services and web applications which can be hosted on your own servers
readme_excerpt: Awesome-Selfhosted Self-hosting is the practice of hosting and managing applications on your own server(s) instead of consuming from SaaSS providers. This is a list of Free Software network services and web applications which can be hosted on your own server(s). Non-Free software is listed on the Non-Free page.
